enonce: Traduis le nom du poste en anglais.
indices: Ils sont tous dans le tableau « Jobs » du cours.
correction: PDG = *CEO* ; stagiaire = *intern* ; intérimaire = *temp* ; prestataire = *contractor* ; commercial = *sales rep* ou *salesperson* ; graphiste = *graphic designer* ; demandeur d'emploi = *job seeker* ; chargé de clientèle = *account manager*.

enonce: Lis la définition et choisis le poste.

questions.intitule: *This person repairs computers and solves network problems.*
*This person checks visitors' badges at the entrance.*
*This person manages the money of the company and prepares the budget.*
*This person organises the director's diary and travel.*
*This person is looking for a job.*
*This person runs a shop floor and supervises the sales staff.*

indices: *diary* = agenda ; *shop floor* = surface de vente.
correction: IT technician (informaticien), security guard (agent de sécurité), CFO (directeur financier), PA (assistant de direction), job seeker (demandeur d'emploi), floor manager (chef de magasin).

enonce: Complète chaque phrase avec le nom du poste (un ou deux mots).

questions.intitule: *The printer is broken again. Can you call the IT ......?*
*Our maintenance ...... checks the machines every night.*
*She started as a summer ...... and the company hired her after her degree.* (stagiaire)
*The board ...... will vote on the new strategy on Monday.* (membres du conseil)
*We hired a ...... from an agency to replace Paul while he is on leave.* (intérimaire)
*Our head of ...... approved my holiday request.* (chef de service)

indices: Les mots manquants complètent des noms composés : *IT ...*, *maintenance ...*, *board ...*, *head of ...*
correction: *IT technician*, *maintenance crew*, *intern*, *board members*, *temp*, *head of department*.

enonce: Donne l'abréviation utilisée en entreprise.
indices: On prend souvent les initiales ; *memo* et *rep* sont des mots raccourcis.
correction: *CFO, VP, HR, R&D, PR, memo, rep, IT*.

enonce: Choisis l'activité qui correspond le mieux au poste.
indices: *stocktaking* = faire l'inventaire ; *troubleshooting* = dépanner.
correction: Graphiste : dessiner (*drawing*) et créer. Chef de magasin : inventaire (*stocktaking*) et supervision. Informaticien : dépannage (*troubleshooting*) et programmation. Chargé de clientèle : conseil (*advising*) et augmentation des ventes. Assistant : coordination (*coordinating*) et saisie.

enonce: Traduis en anglais.
indices: *vacancy* veut aussi dire « chambre libre » à l'hôtel.
En américain, un CV se dit *résumé*.
correction: poste vacant = *vacancy* ; embaucher = *take on* / *hire* ; démissionner = *resign* ; nommer = *appoint* ; pointer = *clock in* ; réduire les effectifs = *downsize* ; évaluation = *appraisal* ; CV = *résumé*.

titre: Les verbes à particule des RH
enonce: Complète avec la bonne particule (*for, on, off, out, from, in*).

questions.intitule: *Don't forget to clock ...... when you arrive in the morning.*
*Because of the crisis, the factory laid ...... 40 workers.*
*She applied ...... a job in the marketing department.*
*He resigned ...... his position after ten years.*
*We need to take ...... two new engineers before the summer.*
*At 6 p.m., the workers clock ...... and go home.*

indices: *apply for, take on, lay off, resign from, be on the shortlist*.
En arrivant : *clock in* ; en partant : *clock out*.
correction: *clock in* (arrivée), *laid off*, *applied for*, *resigned from*, *take on*, *on the shortlist*, *clock out* (départ).

enonce: Lis la situation et choisis le verbe qui convient.

questions.intitule: *Sales have dropped, so the company has to reduce its staff. It will ...... 30 employees.*
*Tom stole money from the cash register. His manager decided to ...... him.*
*Julia found a better job abroad, so she decided to ......*
*Before leaving the company, you must give one month's ......*

indices: *lay off* : raison économique ; *dismiss* : faute ; *resign* : le salarié part.
correction: 1. Raison économique → *lay off*. 2. Faute → *dismiss* (ou *fire*). 3. Elle part d'elle-même → *resign*. 4. *give notice* = donner son préavis. 5. *maternity leave* = congé maternité.

enonce: Traduis en anglais.
indices: Ils sont dans le tableau « Pay & contracts ».
correction: *pay slip*, *overtime*, *trial period*, *perks*, *raise* (US) ou *pay rise* (UK), *amendment*, *volunteer*, *hourly wage*.

enonce: Choisis le mot qui convient.

questions.intitule: *The company has decided to ...... salaries by 3%.*
*I checked my ...... and the overtime was missing.*
*Nobody can read this form: the signature is ......*
*After six months, staff are ...... for health insurance.*
*The ...... web designer sent us an invoice for 20 hours of work.*

indices: *rise* sans complément, *raise* + complément.
Un bénévole (*volunteer*) n'envoie pas de facture.
correction: 1. *rise* (les prix montent tout seuls). 2. *raise salaries* (augmenter quelque chose). 3. *wages* : payés à la semaine. 4. *pay slip* = bulletin de paie (*pink slip* = licenciement). 5. *illegible* = illisible. 6. *eligible* = qui a droit. 7. *freelance* : il facture son travail.

enonce:
Voici un extrait de contrat écrit pour l'exercice. Choisis le mot qui convient.

> *This agreement is made between Brightline Ltd, (1) ...... referred to as "the Client", and Mr. Omar Haddad, referred to as "the Consultant". Both (2) ...... agree to (3) ...... the terms below. This contract is (4) ...... once it has been signed. Any change must be made by written (5) ....... A bonus system, (6) ...... the Consultant receives 5% of new sales, is described in Section 4.*
indices: *hereunder* = ci-dessous ; *whereby* = selon lequel.
*a binding contract* = un contrat qui engage.
correction: (1) *hereunder* (ci-dessous). (2) *Both parties* (les deux parties). (3) *abide by* (respecter). (4) *binding* (qui engage ; *bound* s'emploie avec une personne : *you are bound by the contract*). (5) *amendment* (avenant). (6) *whereby* (selon lequel).

enonce: Traduis en anglais.
indices: Attention : *agenda* est un faux ami (ordre du jour, pas carnet).
correction: *agenda*, *minutes*, *attendee*, *postpone*, *resume*, *chair*, *take place*, *fundraiser*.

enonce: Choisis le mot qui convient.

questions.intitule: *Please read the ...... before tomorrow's meeting so you know what we will discuss.*
*Sarah took the ...... and sent them to everyone after the meeting.*
*The director is ill, so we will ...... the meeting until next week.*
*The client wants to see the plans sooner, so we will ...... the presentation to Monday.*
*The annual convention will ...... in Lisbon this year.*

indices: *agenda* = avant, *minutes* = après.
*bring forward* = avancer ; *postpone* = reporter.
correction: 1. *agenda* (à lire avant). 2. *minutes* (rédigées pendant, envoyées après). 3. *resume* (reprendre). 4. *postpone* (reporter). 5. *bring forward* (avancer). 6. *take place* (avoir lieu) ; *hold* demande un complément ou le passif (*will be held*).

enonce: Complète avec un mot du vocabulaire des événements.

questions.intitule: *Every December, the staff go on an ...... to the mountains.* (sortie)
*Write your ideas on the flip ...... so everyone can see them.*
*Mr. Green will ...... the meeting because the CEO is away.* (présider)
*We are organising a retirement ...... for Jack on Friday.* (pot de départ)

indices: *flip chart* = paper-board ; *retirement reception* = pot de départ à la retraite.
correction: *outing*, *flip chart*, *attendees*, *chair*, *employee of the month*, *retirement reception*.

enonce: Choisis le mot qui complète la phrase (style TOEIC partie 5).

questions.intitule: *The directors meet once a month in the ...... on the top floor.*
*...... a new strategy takes time and money.*
*All ...... of department must send their budgets by Friday.*
*The servers have been carefully ...... since they were installed.*
*He accepted a ...... position to gain experience in an office.*
*Many students do an ...... before they graduate.*
*Paolo works as a ...... and chooses his own projects.*

indices: Regarde le mot juste avant le trou : *the*, *all*, *has been*, *a*...
*-ship* = la chose (le stage) ; *-or* = la personne.
correction: 1. *the* + nom de lieu : *boardroom*. 2. Sujet en début de phrase : *Implementing*. 3. *All* + pluriel : *heads*. 4. *managing director* = directeur général. 5. *have been* + participe passé : *maintained*. 6. adjectif devant *position* : *clerical*. 7. *an* + nom de la chose : *internship*. 8. *work as a* + personne : *contractor*.

enonce: Choisis le mot qui complète la phrase.

questions.intitule: *The ...... of the sales director surprised everyone.*
*We are delighted to announce the ...... of Ms. Kaur as head of HR.*
*Our manager gave the team a lot of ...... for their excellent work.*
*Every ...... must send a cover letter with their résumé.*
*During her annual ......, she asked for more training.*
*He handed in his ...... and left the company a month later.*
*She asked to be ...... to the London office.*
*There is a two-year gap in his ...... history.*

indices: *praise* = des éloges ; *appraisal* = une évaluation.
*to be* + participe passé = passif.
correction: 1. *The* + nom : *dismissal* (le renvoi). 2. *the appointment of* (la nomination). 3. *praise* (éloges). 4. *Every* + personne : *applicant*. 5. *annual assessment*. 6. *hand in one's resignation*. 7. *to be transferred*. 8. *employment history* = parcours professionnel.

titre: Familles de mots : paie et contrats
enonce: Choisis le mot qui complète la phrase.

questions.intitule: *After a long discussion, both companies ...... to work together.*
*The training day starts with an ...... presentation of the company.*
*My brother ...... at a food bank every Saturday.*
*If you work more than 20 hours, you are ...... for paid holidays.*
*Her husband is the ...... of her life insurance.*

indices: *an hour-long presentation* = une présentation d'une heure (adjectif composé).
*be bound by* = être lié par.
correction: 1. passé, sujet pluriel : *agreed*. 2. *bound* (participe passé de *bind*). 3. pluriel avec *will increase* : *salaries*. 4. *an hour-long presentation* : adjectif composé devant le nom (*hourly* = toutes les heures, à l'heure). 5. *My brother volunteers* (3e personne : -s). 6. *eligible for*. 7. *beneficiary* (la personne qui reçoit).

enonce: Choisis le mot qui complète la phrase.

questions.intitule: *The team enjoyed their ...... to the seaside.*
*As a ......, my father now has time for gardening.*
*We printed 2,000 ...... leaflets for the trade fair.*
*After the strike, the ...... of talks took place on Monday.*
*She has never ...... a board meeting before.*
*They are the ...... supplier of solar panels in Europe.*

indices: *retiree* = la personne ; *retirement* = la retraite.
Devant un nom, il faut un adjectif (*leading supplier*).
correction: 1. *their* + nom : *outing*. 2. *As a* + personne : *retiree*. 3. adjectif : *promotional*. 4. *the* + nom : *resumption*. 5. *has never* + participe passé : *chaired*. 6. adjectif : *leading* (*the leading supplier* = le premier fournisseur). 7. *staff attendance* = présence du personnel.

enonce: Écris le nom demandé (un seul mot).
indices: *-ee* = celui qui reçoit l'action ; *-ant* = celui qui fait.
*-ship*, *-tion*, *-ance* forment des noms de choses.
correction: *applicant*, *employee* (*employer* = l'employeur), *attendee*, *retiree*, *internship*, *resignation*, *attendance*.

enonce: Complète l'expression.
indices: *take the minutes*, *hold a meeting*, *chair a meeting*.
correction: *chair a meeting*, *take the minutes*, *go on an outing*, *take early retirement*, *hold a meeting*.

enonce: Donne un synonyme tiré du vocabulaire du chapitre.
indices: Tous ces mots sont dans les quatre tableaux du cours.
correction: *opening* = *vacancy* ; *hire* = *take on* ; *presence* = *attendance* ; *put off* = *postpone* ; *calendar* = *schedule* ; *probationary period* = *trial period* ; *signatory* = *party*.

enonce: Traduis en anglais puis compare avec la réponse modèle.

questions.intitule: Nous allons embaucher deux stagiaires le mois prochain.
questions.reponse: *We are going to take on (hire) two interns next month.*

questions.intitule: La réunion a été reportée à jeudi.
questions.reponse: *The meeting has been postponed until (to) Thursday.*

questions.intitule: Elle a démissionné après sa période d'essai.
Les salariés à temps partiel ont droit aux tickets restaurant.
questions.reponse: *Part-time employees are eligible for meal vouchers.*

indices: embaucher = *take on* ; reporter = *postpone* ; avoir droit à = *be eligible for*.
correction: Vérifie surtout le vocabulaire : *take on*, *intern*, *postpone*, *resign*, *trial period*, *part-time*, *be eligible for*.

titre: Rédiger un court e-mail de candidature
enonce: Écris un e-mail de 3 ou 4 phrases pour postuler à un poste d'*IT technician*. Utilise au moins : *apply for*, *vacancy*, *résumé*, *look forward to*.

questions.reponse:
Exemple :

*Dear Ms. Brown,*

*I am writing to apply for the IT technician vacancy advertised on your website. I have two years of experience in troubleshooting and network maintenance. Please find my résumé attached, and I can provide references if needed. I look forward to hearing from you.*

*Best regards,*
*Alex Martin*

indices: *I am writing to apply for...* est une ouverture classique.
*look forward to* + verbe en -ing : *hearing from you*.
correction: Points à vérifier : formule d'appel (*Dear...*), *apply for the ... vacancy*, *résumé attached*, *I look forward to hearing from you* (avec -ing), formule de fin (*Best regards*).
